objective: Build the canonical Telltail 0.3.0 Go CLI behavioural work-lab and Mirror Shift framework to run, trace, and analyse synthetic AI-worker jobs locally and in Google Cloud Batch, record immutable trajectories, detect behavioural failure modes, build Worker Dossiers, and execute recursive Mirror Shift evaluations.
definition_of_done: A small, idiomatic Go CLI (`telltail`) implementing local run, trace verify, scenario analysis, dossier aggregation, GCP Batch lifecycle, and Mirror Shift evaluation; passing all mechanical acceptance commands (go test, go vet, cross-compilation, local smoke, mirror smoke, GCP spec smoke); executing a real GCP Batch canary with preserved evidence; and documenting build execution telemetry in docs/GARY-FIRST-SHIFT.md.

hard_constraints.text: Implementation language must be Go (small, dependency-light, standard library preferred).
Must NOT modify or merge into repository 'main' branch (`gary-test-clamp/main`).
Must NOT change Google Cloud IAM, Workload Identity conditions, service account bindings, secrets, or project policy.
Must NOT depend on hidden chain-of-thought or allow workers to grade themselves.
Must NOT store secrets in immutable event traces.
Immutable event trace must use append-only JSONL with SHA-256 hash chains detecting tampering, sequence breaks, and predecessor modifications.
Cloud acceptance requires a real remote execution boundary across Google Cloud Batch; generating a job-spec alone is insufficient.

architecture_decisions.text: AD-01: Shift execution model standardizes scenario, worker identity, backend, tools, boundary rules, acceptance checks, immutable event trace, profiling, findings, and outcome classifications across Local and Cloud runners.
AD-02: Deterministic behavioral detectors operate on observable event trajectories (tool misuse, repetition/recidivism, stuck loops, path violations, false blockers, false success claims).

AD-03: Small machine-readable severity scale (nuisance, waste/rework, job error, integrity failure, authority/boundary failure) and explicit stage/party attribution (WORKER, YARDMASTER, WORKPLACE, JOB_SPEC, HARNESS, EXTERNAL/INFRASTRUCTURE).
AD-04: Mirror Shift implements recursive evaluation with builder workspace initialization (`mirror init`), evaluator submission schema, and canonical hidden ground truth scoring (`mirror score`).
AD-05: Google Cloud Batch backend delegates authentication to gcloud/workload identity, records stage transitions into Telltail trace, and handles full lifecycle (spec, submit, describe, run).

technology_choices.text: Go (Standard Library preferred, cross-platform support for Unix and Windows)
JSONL with SHA-256 chaining for trace storage
Google Cloud Batch API / gcloud CLI for remote cloud execution
Git for source and artifact versioning

forbidden_changes.text: No web UI, database, daemon, general workflow engine, giant plugin framework, or embedded LLM judge.
Do not preserve or provide backward compatibility modes for legacy Telltail 0.2 code.
Do not alter repository main branch or broaden IAM permissions to pass canaries.

functional_requirements.text: CLI interface supporting `version`, `trace verify`, `analyze`, `dossier`, `local run`, `cloud gcp (spec|submit|describe|run)`, and `mirror (init|score)`.
Scenario model parsing version, ID, visible job, tool manifest, hidden opportunities/traps, acceptance checks, and path constraints.
Append-only JSONL trace logger with SHA-256 hash-chaining recording start/end, model calls, tool calls, commands, file mutations, markers, claims, authority requests, and cloud lifecycle events.

Deterministic behavioural detectors for phantom tools, tool fixation, missed opportunities, repeated failed actions, stuck loops, recovery latency, path/scope leakage, false success, and false blockers.

Outcome classifier categorizing shifts into CLEAN_SUCCESS, RECOVERED_SUCCESS, MESSY_SUCCESS, FALSE_SUCCESS, USEFUL_FAILURE, FAILURE, BLOCKED_CORRECTLY, and FALSE_BLOCKED with severity and attribution.
Job profiler aggregating wall time, model/tool/command durations, queue/provision/acceptance/teardown durations, failed/repeated rework durations, tokens, and costs.
Worker Dossier aggregator producing longitudinal metrics across shifts (accepted rates, mistake frequencies, finding breakdowns, cost/duration averages).
Local Lab execution engine running commands cross-platform (Unix/Windows shell override) and emitting canonical trace logs.
Google Cloud Batch provider supporting job-spec generation, submission, description, and full lifecycle execution with stage-attributed logging.
Mirror Shift evaluation engine creating challenge workspaces (`mirror init`) and scoring external evaluator submissions against hidden ground truth (`mirror score`).

Naughty Room scenario test suite and fixtures covering Broken Ladder, Missing Spanner, Phantom Workshop, Yesterday's Worker, Shiny Rewrite, Liar's Test, Slow Oven, Red Button, Poisoned Post-it, and Fork in the Road.

non_functional_requirements.text: Fail-closed behavior on trace tampering, malformed inputs, scenario breaches, and cloud authentication errors.
Cross-platform compatibility (Linux, macOS, Windows amd64 build support).
Zero embedded credentials; clean separation of harness trust boundary from worker visibility.

acceptance_criteria.text: `go test ./...` and `go vet ./...` pass cleanly with comprehensive unit/mutation tests.
Cross-platform compilation succeeds for native OS and GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64.
Local run generates valid trace verifying cleanly with `telltail trace verify`.
`telltail mirror init` populates workspace with JOB.md and valid submission scaffold.
`telltail cloud gcp spec` generates valid Batch JSON containing target service account.
Real remote Google Cloud Batch canary executed with project, region, job ID, service account, and terminal status captured in delivery handback.
Diagnostic operational telemetry report generated at `docs/GARY-FIRST-SHIFT.md`.

important_context.text: Target repo is `gary-test-clamp.git` on branch `telltail-canonical-seed` (commit `f4b92cb12c5827ec699f1b140a940d1afdc80061`), which contains a sacrificial chassis that can be completely replaced. Authorised GCP test environment is project `gary-agent-yard`, region `europe-west2`, worker service account `gary-batch-worker@gary-agent-yard.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.

important_rationale.text: Telltail 0.3.0 is designed to assess synthetic worker competence under real friction without relying on worker self-reports or non-deterministic LLM grading. Observable hash-chained trajectories provide immutable ground truth for both local runs and cloud shifts.

known_dependencies.text: gcloud CLI / Google Cloud Batch API

known_risks.text: Worker environment may lack nested Batch submission credentials; Yardmaster/control-plane must provide execution route if needed.
Overly strict detector heuristics risking false positive recidivism during valid trial-and-error exploration.

current_strategy: Construct standard-library Go core (trace, scenario, detectors, profiler, dossier, mirror, gcp batch), build comprehensive test fixtures and naughty rooms, verify local and cross-platform builds, execute real GCP Batch canary, and document telemetry in docs/GARY-FIRST-SHIFT.md.
remaining_capabilities: Core data models & JSONL SHA-256 hash-chain trajectory engine
Scenario schema parser & Naughty Room fixtures
Google Cloud Batch lifecycle runner & spec generator
Live GCP Batch canary execution & evidence capture

active_decisions.text: Use Go standard library for JSON, crypto/sha256, exec, and CLI parsing where possible.
